<script type="text/javascript" id="wh-custom-js">document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const observerOptions = {
        threshold: 0.1, // Trigger when 10% of the element is visible
        rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px' // Trigger 50px before entering view
    };

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                entry.target.classList.add('fade-in');
                observer.unobserve(entry.target); // One-time trigger
            }
        });
    }, observerOptions);

    // Observe all .fade-in-on-scroll elements
    document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in-on-scroll').forEach(el => {
        observer.observe(el);
    });
});


(function() {
    'use strict';

    const CONFIG = {
        totalDelays: 19529,
        totalCancellations: 2558,
        chartData: [
            { day: 'Tue', delays: 4302, cancellations: 151 },
            { day: 'Wed', delays: 4346, cancellations: 171 },
            { day: 'Thu', delays: 7371, cancellations: 202 },
            { day: 'Fri', delays: 3510, cancellations: 953 },
            { day: 'Sat', delays: 0, cancellations: 703 },
            { day: 'Sun', delays: 0, cancellations: 378 }
        ],
        
        counterDuration: 2000,
        barAnimationDelay: 1000,
        tooltipDelay: 1500
    };

    function countUp(target, element, duration) {
        if (!element) return;
        
        let start = 0;
        const increment = target / (duration / 16);
        
        const timer = setInterval(() => {
            if (!element) {
                clearInterval(timer);
                return;
            }
            
            start += increment;
            
            if (start >= target) {
                start = target;
                clearInterval(timer);
            }
            
            element.textContent = Math.floor(start).toLocaleString();
        }, 16);
    }

    function animateBars() {
        const delays = CONFIG.chartData.map(d => d.delays);
        const cancellations = CONFIG.chartData.map(d => d.cancellations);
        const maxValue = Math.max(...delays, ...cancellations);
        
        const barChart = document.querySelector('.whitehouse-ft-bar-chart');
        const maxBarHeight = barChart ? barChart.clientHeight : 120;
        const barGroups = document.querySelectorAll('.whitehouse-ft-bar-group');

        barGroups.forEach((group, index) => {
            const delaysBar = group.querySelector('.whitehouse-ft-bar--delays');
            const cancelsBar = group.querySelector('.whitehouse-ft-bar--cancels');
            
            if (delaysBar && cancelsBar && CONFIG.chartData[index]) {
                const delaysHeight = maxValue > 0 
                    ? (CONFIG.chartData[index].delays / maxValue) * maxBarHeight 
                    : 0;
                const cancelsHeight = maxValue > 0 
                    ? (CONFIG.chartData[index].cancellations / maxValue) * maxBarHeight 
                    : 0;
                
                delaysBar.style.height = `${delaysHeight}px`;
                cancelsBar.style.height = `${cancelsHeight}px`;

                setTimeout(() => {
                    delaysBar.style.animationDelay = `${index * 0.1}s`;
                    cancelsBar.style.animationDelay = `${index * 0.1 + 0.05}s`;
                }, 500);
            }
        });
    }

    function setupTooltips() {
        const tooltip = document.getElementById('whitehouse-ft-tooltip');
        const container = document.querySelector('.whitehouse-ft-ticker-container');
        
        if (!tooltip || !container) return;

        const bars = document.querySelectorAll('.whitehouse-ft-bar');
        
        bars.forEach(bar => {
            bar.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                const value = parseInt(bar.dataset.value) || 0;
                const type = bar.classList.contains('whitehouse-ft-bar--delays') 
                    ? 'Delays' 
                    : 'Cancellations';
                const day = bar.closest('.whitehouse-ft-bar-group').dataset.day;
                
                tooltip.textContent = `${type} on ${day}: ${value.toLocaleString()}`;

                const barRect = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
                const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();

                const relativeTop = barRect.top - containerRect.top - 35;
                const relativeLeft = barRect.left - containerRect.left + (barRect.width / 2) - 60;

                tooltip.style.left = `${Math.max(0, relativeLeft)}px`;
                tooltip.style.top = `${Math.max(0, relativeTop)}px`;
                tooltip.style.opacity = '1';
            });

            bar.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                tooltip.style.opacity = '0';
            });
        });
    }

    function initTicker() {
        const delaysEl = document.getElementById('whitehouse-ft-delays-count');
        const cancelsEl = document.getElementById('whitehouse-ft-cancellations-count');

        if (!delaysEl || !cancelsEl) {
            setTimeout(initTicker, 100);
            return;
        }

        countUp(CONFIG.totalDelays, delaysEl, CONFIG.counterDuration);
        countUp(CONFIG.totalCancellations, cancelsEl, CONFIG.counterDuration);

        setTimeout(animateBars, CONFIG.barAnimationDelay);
        setTimeout(setupTooltips, CONFIG.tooltipDelay);
    }

    function setupCloseButton() {
        const closeBtn = document.querySelector('.whitehouse-ft-ticker-close');
        const ticker = document.getElementById('whitehouse-ft-ticker');
        
        if (closeBtn && ticker) {
            closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                ticker.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease';
                ticker.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => ticker.remove(), 300);
            });
        }
    }

    function setupFadeIn() {
        const ticker = document.querySelector('.whitehouse-ft-ticker-container');
        if (ticker) {
            setTimeout(() => ticker.classList.add('whitehouse-ft-loaded'), 100);
        }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            setTimeout(initTicker, 100);
            setupCloseButton();
            setupFadeIn();
        });
    } else {
        setTimeout(initTicker, 100);
        setupCloseButton();
        setupFadeIn();
    }

})();</script><style type="text/css" id="wh-custom-css">/* Initial hidden state for fade-in-on-scroll elements */
.fade-in-on-scroll {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(40px);  /* Adjust distance: 20px–60px common */
    transition: opacity 1s ease, transform 1s ease;  /* Smooth fade + slide up */
}

/* Active state when .fade-in is added */
.fade-in-on-scroll.fade-in {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
}

.fade-in-on-scroll:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
.fade-in-on-scroll:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
.fade-in-on-scroll:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
.fade-in-on-scroll:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.4s; }

<p class="justified fade-in-on-scroll wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px">Under President Donald Trump’s second administration, the United States has surged into a new era of prosperity, marked by record-setting economic growth and trillions in new private-sector investments fueled by tax reforms, deregulation, and a renewed focus on American innovation. </p>



<p class="justified fade-in-on-scroll wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px">The nation has solidified its position as the global leader in artificial intelligence, with record-setting capital expenditures driving productivity and technological advancement. </p>



<p class="justified fade-in-on-scroll wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px">At home, decisive policies have secured the southern border, reducing illegal entries to historic lows unseen in decades and restoring national sovereignty, while energy dominance and cost-cutting measures have significantly improved affordability for families.</p>



<p class="justified fade-in-on-scroll wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px">Abroad, a doctrine of peace through strength has secured alliances, ended eight wars, and positioned America as an indispensable force for global stability. As these achievements compound, we have unmistakably entered a Golden Age of American greatness, promising even greater opportunity and security ahead.</p>

    { id: 'patriot-games', title: 'Patriot Games national competition', start: '2026-10-15', end: '2026-10-15', location: 'To be announced', category: 'signature', desc: 'A national competition for high school athletes from every state and territory, each paired with a mentor. One male and one female winner split a $250,000 prize. Fall 2026; final date TBA.', url: 'https://www.whitehouse.gov/freedom250/' }
  ];

  const ICON = {
    pin: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 10c0 7-9 13-9 13s-9-6-9-13a9 9 0 0 1 18 0z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/></svg>',
    cal: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"/><line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"/><line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"/></svg>',
    arrow: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="7" y1="17" x2="17" y2="7"/><polyline points="7 7 17 7 17 17"/></svg>'
  };

  function parseDate(s) { const [y, m, d] = s.split('-').map(Number); return new Date(y, m - 1, d); }
  function fmtYMD(d) { return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); }
  function eventsOnDate(dateStr) {
    const d = parseDate(dateStr);
    return EVENTS.filter(e => { const s = parseDate(e.start), en = parseDate(e.end); return d >= s && d <= en; });
  }
  function getToday() { const n = new Date(); return new Date(n.getFullYear(), n.getMonth(), n.getDate()); }
  function badgeLabel(cat) { return cat === 'featured' ? 'Featured' : (cat === 'ongoing' ? 'Ongoing' : 'Signature'); }
  function formatDateRange(e) {
    const s = parseDate(e.start), en = parseDate(e.end);
    const sameDay = e.start === e.end;
    const sameMonth = s.getMonth() === en.getMonth() && s.getFullYear() === en.getFullYear();
    if (sameDay) return s.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
    if (sameMonth) return s.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }) + '–' + en.getDate() + ', ' + en.getFullYear();
    return s.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }) + ' – ' + en.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
  }
  function buildEventBlock(e) {
    const cls = e.category === 'featured' ? 'feat' : (e.category === 'ongoing' ? 'ongoing' : '');
    return '<a class="f250-event-block ' + cls + '" href="' + e.url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' +
      '<div class="f250-event-block-head">' +
        '<h3 class="f250-event-block-title">' + e.title + '<span class="f250-badge ' + cls + '">' + badgeLabel(e.category) + '</span></h3>' +
        '<span class="f250-event-block-arrow">' + ICON.arrow + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="f250-event-block-meta">' +
        '<span class="f250-event-block-meta-item">' + ICON.pin + e.location + '</span>' +
        '<span class="f250-event-block-meta-item">' + ICON.cal + formatDateRange(e) + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<p class="f250-event-block-desc">' + e.desc + '</p>' +
    '</a>';
  }

  function updateCountdown() {
    const now = new Date();
    const diff = INDEPENDENCE - now;
    const el = document.getElementById('f250-cd-days');
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = diff <= 0 ? '0' : Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
  }
  updateCountdown();
  setInterval(updateCountdown, 60000);

  const today = getToday();
  let viewYear = 2026;
  let viewMonth = today.getFullYear() === 2026 ? Math.max(today.getMonth(), 5) : 5;
  if (today.getFullYear() > 2026) { viewYear = 2026; viewMonth = 11; }
  let selectedDate = null;

  const MONTHS = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];
  const DOW = ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];
  const MIN_YEAR = 2026, MIN_MONTH = today.getFullYear() === 2026 ? Math.max(today.getMonth(), 5) : 5;
  const MAX_YEAR = 2026, MAX_MONTH = 11;

  function renderGrid() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('f250-grid');
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    DOW.forEach(d => { const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = 'f250-cal-dow'; el.textContent = d; grid.appendChild(el); });
    const first = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, 1);
    const firstDow = first.getDay();
    const daysInMonth = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth + 1, 0).getDate();
    const totalCells = Math.ceil((firstDow + daysInMonth) / 7) * 7;
    for (let i = 0; i < totalCells; i++) {
      const cell = document.createElement('div');
      const dayNum = i - firstDow + 1;
      if (dayNum < 1 || dayNum > daysInMonth) { cell.className = 'f250-cal-day empty'; grid.appendChild(cell); continue; }
      const dateObj = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, dayNum);
      const dateStr = fmtYMD(dateObj);
      const evs = eventsOnDate(dateStr);
      const isPast = dateObj < today;
      const isToday = dateObj.getTime() === today.getTime();
      const hasFeat = evs.some(e => e.category === 'featured');
      const onlyOngoing = evs.length > 0 && evs.every(e => e.category === 'ongoing');
      cell.className = 'f250-cal-day';
      if (evs.length > 0) cell.classList.add('has-event');
      if (isPast && !isToday) cell.classList.add('dim');
      if (isToday) cell.classList.add('today');
      if (hasFeat) cell.classList.add('has-feat');
      else if (onlyOngoing) cell.classList.add('has-ongoing-only');
      if (selectedDate === dateStr) cell.classList.add('selected');
      const num = document.createElement('div'); num.className = 'f250-cal-day-num'; num.textContent = dayNum; cell.appendChild(num);
      if (evs.length > 0) {
        const dots = document.createElement('div'); dots.className = 'f250-day-dots';
        const seen = new Set();
        evs.forEach(e => {
          if (seen.has(e.category)) return; seen.add(e.category);
          const dot = document.createElement('span');
          dot.className = 'f250-day-dot' + (e.category === 'featured' ? ' feat' : e.category === 'ongoing' ? ' ongoing' : '');
          dots.appendChild(dot);
        });
        cell.appendChild(dots);
        cell.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        cell.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
        cell.setAttribute('aria-label', dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { dateStyle: 'long' }) + ', ' + evs.length + ' event' + (evs.length > 1 ? 's' : ''));
        cell.addEventListener('click', () => { selectedDate = (selectedDate === dateStr) ? null : dateStr; renderGrid(); renderDetail(); });
        cell.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); cell.click(); } });
      }
      grid.appendChild(cell);
    }
  }

  function nextUpcoming() {
    const u = EVENTS.filter(e => { const en = parseDate(e.end); return en >= today && e.category !== 'ongoing'; });
    u.sort((a, b) => parseDate(a.start) - parseDate(b.start));
    return u[0] || null;
  }

  function renderDetail() {
    const eyebrow = document.getElementById('f250-detail-eyebrow');
    const content = document.getElementById('f250-detail-content');
    if (!selectedDate) {
      const nxt = nextUpcoming();
      if (nxt) { eyebrow.textContent = 'Next on the calendar'; content.innerHTML = buildEventBlock(nxt); }
      else { eyebrow.textContent = 'Browse the calendar'; content.innerHTML = '<div class="f250-detail-empty">Tap a highlighted day to see events.</div>'; }
      return;
    }
    const d = parseDate(selectedDate);
    const evs = eventsOnDate(selectedDate);
    eyebrow.textContent = d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
    content.innerHTML = evs.map(buildEventBlock).join('');
  }

  function renderMonthLabel() {
    document.getElementById('f250-month-label').innerHTML = MONTHS[viewMonth] + ' <em>' + viewYear + '</em>';
    document.getElementById('f250-prev').disabled = (viewYear === MIN_YEAR && viewMonth <= MIN_MONTH);
    document.getElementById('f250-next').disabled = (viewYear === MAX_YEAR && viewMonth >= MAX_MONTH);
  }

  document.getElementById('f250-prev').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (viewYear === MIN_YEAR && viewMonth <= MIN_MONTH) return;
    viewMonth--; if (viewMonth < 0) { viewMonth = 11; viewYear--; }
    selectedDate = null; renderMonthLabel(); renderGrid(); renderDetail();
  });
  document.getElementById('f250-next').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (viewYear === MAX_YEAR && viewMonth >= MAX_MONTH) return;
    viewMonth++; if (viewMonth > 11) { viewMonth = 0; viewYear++; }
    selectedDate = null; renderMonthLabel(); renderGrid(); renderDetail();
  });

  const modalBackdrop = document.getElementById('f250-modal-backdrop');
  const fab = document.getElementById('f250-fab');
  let lastFocused = null;
  function openModal() {
    lastFocused = document.activeElement;
    modalBackdrop.classList.add('open');
    modalBackdrop.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    fab.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    document.body.classList.add('f250-modal-open');
    setTimeout(() => { document.getElementById('f250-modal-close').focus(); }, 50);
  }
  function closeModal() {
    modalBackdrop.classList.remove('open');
    modalBackdrop.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    fab.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    document.body.classList.remove('f250-modal-open');
    if (lastFocused && typeof lastFocused.focus === 'function') lastFocused.focus();
  }
  fab.addEventListener('click', openModal);
  document.getElementById('f250-modal-close').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  modalBackdrop.addEventListener('click', (ev) => { if (ev.target === modalBackdrop) closeModal(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => { if (ev.key === 'Escape' && modalBackdrop.classList.contains('open')) closeModal(); });

  renderMonthLabel(); renderGrid(); renderDetail();

window.addEventListener('scroll', ()=> {
const scrollHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
const currentPosition = window.innerHeight + window.scrollY;

if (currentPosition >= scrollHeight){
fab.style.display = 'none';
} else {
fab.style.display = '';
}
});
})();

					WHValidation.watch(form);const countryDenylist = JSON.parse( form['country'].dataset.denylist );

			form['country'].addEventListener( 'input', () => {
				const lowerCountry = form['country'].value.toLowerCase().replace( /\s+/g, ' ' ).trim();
				const lowerCountryDenylist = countryDenylist.map( item => item.toLowerCase().replace( /\s+/g, ' ' ).trim() );
				if ( form['otherCountry'].checked && lowerCountryDenylist.indexOf( lowerCountry ) >= 0 ) {
					form['country'].setCustomValidity( countryDenylistMessage );
				} else {
					form['country'].setCustomValidity( '' );
				}
			} );
			form['otherCountry'].addEventListener( 'change', () => {
				form['country'].setCustomValidity( '' );
				WHValidation.clearInvalid( form['country'] );
			} );WHSubmit.watch(form);const messageType = form['Subject'];
			const addMessageType = ( text, callback ) => {
				const option = new Option( text, '' );
				messageType.appendChild( option );

				messageType.addEventListener( 'change', () => {
					const selectedText = messageType.options[ messageType.options.selectedIndex ].text;

					if ( text === selectedText ) {
						messageType.setCustomValidity( 'Please select an item in the list.' ); // Prevent submission
						callback();
					} else {
						messageType.setCustomValidity( '' );
					}
				} );

<script type="text/javascript" id="wh-custom-js">document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const observerOptions = {
        threshold: 0.1,
        rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px'   // triggers a bit earlier — feels nice
    };

    // ── 1. Normal fade-in-on-scroll elements (your original behavior) ──
    const normalObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                entry.target.classList.add('fade-in');
                normalObserver.unobserve(entry.target); // one-time
            }
        });
    }, observerOptions);

    document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in-on-scroll').forEach(el => {
        normalObserver.observe(el);
    });

    // ── 2. Staggered grids (new behavior) ──
    const staggerObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                const container = entry.target;
                const items = container.querySelectorAll('.stagger-item');

                items.forEach((item, index) => {
                    // Adjust delay here — 100–150ms usually feels very natural
                    const delayMs = index * 120;   // ← tune this (80–180ms)

                    setTimeout(() => {
                        item.classList.add('is-visible');
                    }, delayMs);
                });

                staggerObserver.unobserve(container); // one-time
            }
        });
    }, observerOptions);

    // Observe all stagger containers (you can have multiple on the page)
    document.querySelectorAll('.stagger-grid').forEach(container => {
        staggerObserver.observe(container);
    });
});</script><style type="text/css" id="wh-custom-css">/* Initial hidden state for fade-in-on-scroll elements */
.fade-in-on-scroll {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(40px);  /* Adjust distance: 20px–60px common */
    transition: opacity 1s ease, transform 1s ease;  /* Smooth fade + slide up */
}

/* Active state when .fade-in is added */
.fade-in-on-scroll.fade-in {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
}

.fade-in-on-scroll:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
.fade-in-on-scroll:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
.fade-in-on-scroll:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
/* Add more as needed */

/* ── NEW: Staggered grid only ── */
.stagger-grid .stagger-item {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(40px);
    transition: opacity 0.9s ease, transform 0.9s ease;
}

.stagger-grid .stagger-item.is-visible {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
}

<div class="wp-block-cover alignfull has-parallax has-custom-content-position is-position-bottom-center is-style-default" style="min-height:800px;aspect-ratio:unset;"><div class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-33193 size-large has-parallax" style="background-position:50% 50%;background-image:url(https://www.whitehouse.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/POTUS-Great-Healthcare-Plan.jpg?w=1200)"></div><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-10 has-background-dim"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center fade-in-on-scroll has-display-font-size" style="letter-spacing:-5px;text-transform:capitalize">The <em>Great </em>Healthcare Plan</h1>
</div></div>



<div style="height:25px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<div class="wp-block-group fade-in-on-scroll has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<figure class="wp-block-embed is-type-video is-provider-youtube wp-block-embed-youtube wp-embed-aspect-16-9 wp-has-aspect-ratio"><div class="wp-block-embed__wrapper">
<iframe title="The Great Healthcare Plan" width="500" height="281" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/fUzNupJidq4?feature=oembed&enablejsapi=1" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</div></figure>
</div>



<div style="height:25px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<div class="wp-block-group fade-in-on-scroll justified is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center has-nord-font-family" style="font-size:18px;font-style:normal;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:2px">CALLING ON CONGRESS TO LOWER HEALTHCARE COSTS</h3>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-group fade-in-on-scroll justified has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-16c44dcd wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px">President Donald J. Trump is calling on Congress to enact the Great Healthcare Plan, a comprehensive plan to lower drug prices, lower insurance premiums, hold big insurance companies accountable, and maximize price transparency.</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-group fade-in-on-scroll justified has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-16c44dcd wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center has-nord-font-family" style="font-size:18px;font-style:normal;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:2px">LOWERING DRUG PRICES</h3>



<p class="has-instrument-sans-font-family wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px;font-style:normal;font-weight:400">The Great Healthcare Plan calls for codifying the Trump Administration’s Most-Favored-Nation deals to get Americans the same low prices for prescription drugs that people in other countries pay. This would build off President Trump’s landmark actions that made insulin more affordable in his first term and the successful voluntary negotiations following his recent Executive Order to lower drug prices. Voluntarily negotiated deals with HHS/CMS will be grandfathered in.  </p>



<p class="has-instrument-sans-font-family wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px;font-style:normal;font-weight:400">The Great Healthcare Plan makes more verified safe pharmaceutical drugs available for over-the-counter purchase. This will lower healthcare costs and increase consumer choice by strengthening price transparency, increasing competition, and reducing the need for costly and time-consuming doctor’s visits.</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-group fade-in-on-scroll is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center has-nord-font-family" style="font-size:18px;font-style:normal;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:2px">lowering insurance premiums</h3>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-group fade-in-on-scroll has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-16c44dcd wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="justified has-instrument-sans-font-family wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px;font-style:normal;font-weight:400">The Great Healthcare Plan stops sending big insurance companies billions in extra taxpayer-funded subsidy payments and instead send that money directly to eligible Americans to allow them to buy the health insurance of their choice.</p>



<p class="justified has-instrument-sans-font-family wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px;font-style:normal;font-weight:400">The Great Healthcare Plan funds a cost-sharing reduction program for healthcare plans which would save taxpayers at least $36 billion and reduce the most common Obamacare plan premiums by over 10% according to the Congressional Budget Office.</p>



<p class="justified has-instrument-sans-font-family wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px;font-style:normal;font-weight:400">The Great Healthcare Plan will end the kickbacks paid by pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) to the large brokerage middlemen that deceptively raise the cost of health insurance.</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-group fade-in-on-scroll has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center has-nord-font-family" style="font-size:18px;font-style:normal;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:2px">HOLDing BIG INSURANCE COMPANIES ACCOUNTABLE</h3>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-group fade-in-on-scroll justified has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-16c44dcd wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="justified wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px">The Great Healthcare Plan creates the “Plain English Insurance” Standard by requiring health insurance companies to publish rate and coverage comparisons upfront on their websites in plain English—not industry jargon—so consumers can make better insurance purchasing decisions.</p>



<p class="justified wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px">The Great Healthcare Plan will require health insurance companies to publish the percentage of their revenues that are paid out to claims versus overhead costs and profits on their websites.</p>



<p class="justified wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px">The Great Healthcare Plan will require health insurance companies to publish the percentage of insurance claims they reject and average wait times for routine care on their websites.</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-group fade-in-on-scroll justified has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-16c44dcd wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center has-nord-font-family" style="font-size:18px;font-style:normal;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:2px">maximize price transparency</h3>



<p class="has-text-align-left justified wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:14px">The Great Healthcare Plan requires any healthcare provider or insurer who accepts Medicare or Medicaid to prominently post their pricing and fees in their place of business. </p>
</div>

Video Contact The White House X Instagram TikTok Share Icon Share Icon Facebook YouTube The Great Healthcare Plan CALLING ON CONGRESS TO LOWER HEALTHCARE COSTS President Donald J. Trump is calling on Congress to enact the Great Healthcare Plan, a comprehensive plan to lower drug prices, lower insurance premiums, hold big insurance companies accountable, and maximize price transparency. LOWERING DRUG PRICES The Great Healthcare Plan calls for codifying the Trump Administration’s Most-Favored-Nation deals to get Americans the same low prices for prescription drugs that people in other countries pay. This would build off President Trump’s landmark actions that made insulin more affordable in his first term and the successful voluntary negotiations following his recent Executive Order to lower drug prices. Voluntarily negotiated deals with HHS/CMS will be grandfathered in.   The Great Healthcare Plan makes more verified safe pharmaceutical drugs available for over-the-counter purchase. This will lower healthcare costs and increase consumer choice by strengthening price transparency, increasing competition, and reducing the need for costly and time-consuming doctor’s visits. lowering insurance premiums The Great Healthcare Plan stops sending big insurance companies billions in extra taxpayer-funded subsidy payments and instead send that money directly to eligible Americans to allow them to buy the health insurance of their choice. The Great Healthcare Plan funds a cost-sharing reduction program for healthcare plans which would save taxpayers at least $36 billion and reduce the most common Obamacare plan premiums by over 10% according to the Congressional Budget Office. The Great Healthcare Plan will end the kickbacks paid by pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) to the large brokerage middlemen that deceptively raise the cost of health insurance. HOLDing BIG INSURANCE COMPANIES ACCOUNTABLE The Great Healthcare Plan creates the “Plain English Insurance” Standard by requiring health insurance companies to publish rate and coverage comparisons upfront on their websites in plain English—not industry jargon—so consumers can make better insurance purchasing decisions. The Great Healthcare Plan will require health insurance companies to publish the percentage of their revenues that are paid out to claims versus overhead costs and profits on their websites. The Great Healthcare Plan will require health insurance companies to publish the percentage of insurance claims they reject and average wait times for routine care on their websites. maximize price transparency The Great Healthcare Plan requires any healthcare provider or insurer who accepts Medicare or Medicaid to prominently post their pricing and fees in their place of business. view the fact sheet Slash Prescription Drug Prices Fund Cost-Sharing Reduction Program Publish Costs of Overhead vs. Claim Rates Allow More Over-the-Counter Medicines Cut Kickback Costs Display Claim Denial Rates Send Money Directly to the American People Create the “Plain-English Insurance” Standard Post Prices on the Wall Simple.
